shellCommands.command: cat package.json && git ls-files && find . -path ./node_modules -prune -o -type f -print | grep -v .git/ | head -50 && ls node_modules/next/dist/docs/ && grep -rl "updateTag" node_modules/next/dist/docs/ | head
cat app/page.tsx app/layout.tsx next.config.ts; find node_modules/next/dist/docs -name "*updateTag*" -o -name "*revalidateTag*" | xargs cat
cd node_modules/next/dist/docs; f=$(find . -name "*cacheTag*"); sed -n 1,40p $f; grep -rn "cacheComponents: true" 01-app/03-api-reference/01-directives/*use-cache.md | head -3
cd /workspace && grep -n paths tsconfig.json; npx next build 2>&1 | tail -20
